clues.value: In the mystical Scottish Highlands, ▇▇▇ is the princess of a kingdom ruled by King ▇▇▇ and Queen ▇▇▇. An unruly daughter and an accomplished archer, ▇▇▇ one day defies a sacred custom of the land and inadvertently brings turmoil to the kingdom. In an attempt to set things right, ▇▇▇ seeks out an eccentric old Wise Woman and is granted an ill-fated wish.
